subject: Operating Rules and Onboarding Procedures
overview: The subcommittee met to establish a framework for the newly formed High School Building Committee, focusing on meeting protocols, public participation rules, and educational resources for members. The subcommittee approved a draft set of operating rules and an onboarding checklist to be presented to the full committee.

items.title: Call to Order
items.summary: Chairperson Graham opened the meeting and conducted a roll call of subcommittee members.

items.title: Subcommittee Objectives
items.summary: The chair outlined the meeting goals, which included establishing operating rules for the large committee and defining public participation policies.

items.title: Draft Operating Rules
items.summary: Member Ruseau presented a draft of operating rules covering the use of the 'SBC' acronym, adherence to Robert's Rules of Order, and media communication protocols.

items.title: Public Participation Policy
items.summary: The subcommittee agreed to adopt standard school committee rules for public comment, limiting individual speakers to three minutes on agenda-specific items.

items.title: Committee Naming and Decorum
items.summary: Members discussed balancing formality with collegiality, deciding to address each other by first names while maintaining titles for the Mayor and Superintendent.

items.title: Voting and Procedural Rules
items.summary: The subcommittee clarified procedures for motions, voice votes, and the specific rights of voting versus non-voting members during meetings.

items.title: Administrative and Consent Agendas
items.summary: The subcommittee discussed the use of consent agendas for non-controversial items and the protocol for taking agenda items out of order.

items.title: Member Onboarding Checklist
items.summary: The group developed a living onboarding document including Open Meeting Law training, MSBA process overviews, and administrative setup for new members.

items.title: Exemplar Districts and Educational Resources
items.summary: Members identified neighboring districts like Arlington and Belmont to serve as models and proposed a resource website for the committee.

items.title: Approval of Rules and Onboarding
items.summary: Approved the draft operating rules and onboarding checklist to be reported to the full High School Building Committee.
